service_def.name: PanTiltJointPositionDriver
service_def.description: The function of the Pan Tilt Joint Position Driver is to perform closed-loop joint position control. A single target is provided via the Set Pan Tilt Joint Position message. The target remains unchanged until a new Set Pan Tilt Joint Position message is received. To ensure backward compatibility with 1.0 implementations of this service, it is recommended that this service be co-located on the same component as a Pan Tilt Specification Service and a Pan Tilt Motion Profile Service.
service_def.assumptions: Messages may be delayed, lost, or reordered.

message_def.name: QueryCommandedPanTiltJointPositions
message_def.description: This message shall cause the receiving service to reply to the requestor with a ID 4628h: ReportCommandedPanTiltJointPositions message.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: SetPanTiltJointPositions
message_def.description: This message sets the desired joint position values for a pan tilt mechanism.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ReportCommandedPanTiltJointPositions
message_def.description: This message provides the receiver with the current motion profile for the pan tilt mechanism.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message
